news.why: Gemini 4 Argon is hype-heavy and the topic brief asks to keep Google's benchmark claims apart from same-day independent results; a two-column table does that directly. It leads because it is the biggest story of the window.

research.why: Single paper with a clear mechanism (co-cheating between a problem-writer and a solver) and a proposed fix; the explainer labels map to found / how it works / why it matters / uncertain. Used only here, so the once-per-issue rule holds.

invention.why: Stillwet is a visual, easy-to-skim novelty (code-driven paint simulator, brushstrokes as code, blind AI judging). Three short mini-paragraphs fit 350 words and leave room for the honest caveat. Avoids comparison, used for invention last issue.
